findings.motion: House: Third consideration and final passage (PN 1688)
findings.note: House roll call as printed ('Shaffer'), linked to Jeremy Shaffer (district 28) via the official 2025-2026 House member roll (identity step 2026-10-31, pa-01 HB 1396 nays).

findings.passage: On the Second Amendment right to bear arms, "I don't believe the government should step in and put undue restrictions on that."
findings.note: Quoted by CBS Pittsburgh (KDKA) in an interview during his 2022 run for Congress. The outlet's sentence frames the quote; the quoted words are his.

findings.passage: "If we're looking at red flag laws, obviously, I think all of us would agree that someone who has mental issues or is physically violent, they should not be in possession of a firearm," says Shaffer.
findings.note: Quoted by CBS Pittsburgh (KDKA) in the same 2022 congressional-race interview, on red flag laws and who may have a gun.
subjects: limits on who may have a gun

findings.passage: Question: "What restrictions on gun ownership are needed to protect public safety?" Answer: "-"
findings.note: 2022 congressional-race voter guide: no answer given to the gun-restrictions question. Also marked "Choose not to answer" on whether gun-violence victims should be able to sue dealers and makers.

Third-party tracker lists him as one of 48 cosponsors of HB 548 (prime sponsor Josh Bashline), which amends the firearms and municipalities titles on limits on local regulation of firearms and ammunition. Referred to Judiciary 2025-02-11. Official page not confirmed. Act is cosponsor.
subjects: state preemption of local gun rules
